title: Audit export presets with temporal sampling and federated filter hints
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Problem: Customers need fast, repeatable exports of audit data from the Console for investigations and compliance. Current export flows require building ad-hoc filters and either full-range exports (which are expensive) or repeated short queries. This ticket implements a first-class concept of 'export presets' that combine federated filter hints (user/org/time model) with temporal sampling policies (head/tail sampling, uniform sampling, and cursor-based incremental exports) and a streaming CSV/JSON export API.
acceptance_criteria: Console: Users can save an export preset from the Audit viewer that includes filters, time-window defaults, sampling policy, and output format (CSV/JSON)
API: A new /exports endpoint supports synchronous small exports and asynchronous streaming jobs for large date ranges, returning a cursor for incremental retrieval
Performance: Large exports (30 days, 100M events) stream without memory spikes on the server; end-to-end export throughput >= 150MB/s when using streaming workers
Pagination: Cursor semantics documented; subsequent calls with cursor resume from last checkpoint and support idempotent retries
RBAC: Export permission honors RBAC v2 policies; users cannot export events they cannot view in the console
Audit trail: Each export job generates an internal audit event linking the job to the owner and applied preset
Saved queries: Presets appear in saved queries list and are versioned; users can share presets with teams/orgs respecting sharing rules
implementation_notes: Add ExportPreset model: name, owner_id, filters (serialized), time_hint, sampling_policy, format, shared_with (org/team IDs)
Server: Implement streaming export worker that reads from audit-store partitioned by time and emits newline-delimited JSON or CSV rows; use backpressure to limit memory
Cursor: Persist minimal export checkpoint (partition_id, offset, last_ts) in durable store; design for eventual compaction to keep cursor size < 1KB
Sampling: Implement three policies: head-tail (first/last N%), uniform (probabilistic), and deterministic stride (every Kth event) for reproducible exports
Permissions: Query plan must apply RBAC filters at scan time; forbid bypass of row-level policies. Add integration tests for role permutations
API surface: POST /v1/audit/exports -> {job_id,cursor_url}; GET /v1/audit/exports/{job_id}?cursor=... returns chunk with next_cursor or status
Console UX: 'Save export preset' modal with preview count; show estimated size and cost estimate using quick cardinality sampling
Observability: Emit export_job.metrics: bytes_emitted, duration_ms, errors, rows_scanned, sample_rate_estimate; surface in Console Ops panel
rollout_plan: Feature flagged behind 'export_presets' gated by org-level opt-in
Phase 1 (Beta): Internal + security team + 3 pilot customers. Monitor export_job.metrics and memory usage for 7 days
Phase 2: Allow org-level sharing and increase concurrency limits (scale workers) after memory regression window passes
Phase 3: GA and include in Console release notes; enable for all new orgs by default and backfill existing saved filters as 'legacy presets'
testing_and_metrics: Unit tests for sampling determinism and cursor checkpointing
Integration tests for RBAC permutations ensuring exported rows <= visible rows
Load test: simulate 100 concurrent large exports (each 30d) and ensure 99th percentile latency for stream chunk < 5s
SLOs: export job success rate >= 99.5% for jobs < 1GB; worker OOMs must be 0 in load window
Dashboards: Export job success/failure, average throughput, cursor resume rate, and preview accuracy (estimate vs actual)
